title: Integrated Escalation Contexthub for Ops Notifications
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a small, centralized 'contexthub' service and integration layer that enriches PagerDuty incidents and Slack alerts with structured context: trace links, relevant dashboards, pre-populated runbook snippets, and an auto-created postmortem skeleton. Goal is to reduce mean time to context (MTTC) for on-call responders, eliminate repetitive copy/paste when escalating, and standardize attachments for downstream automation (postmortem creation, root-cause tagging, and triage routing).
acceptance_criteria: PagerDuty incidents triggered by SLO/alerting rules include a context payload with: trace URL, top-3 related graphs, and a 'recommended runbook' link
Slack alert posts (ops channels) include the same context payload and an action button to 'Create Postmortem Draft'
Notification fanout deduplicates events originating from the same root cause within a 5 minute window
Postmortem skeleton is created in Confluence (or our docs repo) with incident metadata and a placeholder timeline when 'Create Postmortem Draft' is clicked
All additions are toggled behind a feature flag per-team and have opt-out for high-sensitivity incidents
End-to-end integration covered by automated E2E tests and a runbook for SREs to disable the fanout in emergencies
comments: 2026-02-26 Aisha: Initial RFC posted to Confluence (link in attachments). Seeking feedback from SRE and Product. Identified PD and Slack as first targets; future extension to MS Teams is possible.

2026-03-02 Marco: Design review done. Decided to implement the contexthub as a lightweight service that subscribes to observability event stream and exposes a small webhook transformation layer for PD/Slack. Will store minimal state for dedupe windows.
2026-03-05 Priya (SRE): Raised concern about exposing trace links for PII-sensitive traces. Added requirement to respect trace redaction flags and to consult security review.
2026-03-09 Marco: PR opened with service scaffold and feature-flagging (github.com/redwood-inference/rw-contexthub/pull/18). Deployment to staging successful; smoke tests passing.

2026-03-12 Aisha: Running a small cohort pilot with two teams (Realtime Search and Console). Observability dashboard link templates verified; postmortem draft creation works in staging. Need QA plan for production rollout.
2026-03-12 Security: Security review requested and scheduled for 2026-03-15.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Staging pilot with two internal teams behind feature flag (done)
Phase 1: Canary production rollout for internal-only alerts (1 week), monitor false positives and rate of postmortem creations
Phase 2: Open to all teams with opt-out and per-team toggles, update runbook attachments for top 20 alert rules
Phase 3: Evaluate extension to third-party channels (PagerDuty SMS, MS Teams) and refine dedupe heuristics
testing_plan: Unit tests for payload transformation and redaction rules
Integration tests that simulate an alert -> contexthub -> PD/Slack flow in CI staging
E2E runbook attachment validation that checks that linked dashboards and traces resolve for test incidents
Chaos test: temporary PD webhook failures and ensure fallback (store-and-retry) does not duplicate incidents
notes_on_privacy: Contexthub must obey trace redaction flags and consult KMS for any short-lived presigned URLs. By default do not include PII fields in incident context. Security review required before production rollout.
